name: Hand saw
notes: Rest pose: lying flat on the bench on the tote cheek and the toe. Points: grip, toe, heel.
parts: taper-ground steel plate, 20 in tooth line, breasted back edge
8 PPI crosscut teeth along the bottom edge with alternate set
closed hardwood tote with hand hole, top and bottom horns, rounded-over edges
three slotted brass split nuts through the tote cheek
lacquer worn through on the grip and thumb rest
style: Well-used but cared-for panel saw: bright plate with faint grind lines, warm lacquered tote rubbed pale where the hand goes, aged brass.
summary: 20 in crosscut panel saw: taper-ground steel plate with set 8 PPI teeth, apple tote with three brass split nuts and a hand-worn grip.
